d: In this video, Firstpost examines America's two-pronged strategy to pressure Iran. The US Navy has ordered 82 additional Lionfish unmanned underwater vehicles, taking its planned fleet to 175. Designed for mine detection, surveillance, intelligence gathering and anti-submarine warfare, the systems could strengthen America's ability to operate in contested waters. At the same time, the Trump administration has announced fresh sanctions targeting more than two dozen Iranian exchange houses, overseas front companies and financial operatives. Washington accuses these networks of helping Tehran…
